title: SA-2 Samson (Avatar)

sources.title: AT-99 Scorpion Gunship from Avatar (Fantastic Plastic)

intro: The SA-2 Samson is the fictional utility aircraft of the RDA in Avatar (2009), with two ducted rotors like the Scorpion. Two pilots sit side by side ahead of an open cabin; the pilot flies with cyclic and collective, and door gunners handle the guns. The pilot has no fixed forward weapons.

areas.name: Cyclic and collective
areas.text: The hand controls the pilot flies with.

panels.name: Cyclic
panels.text: The cyclic stick in front of the Samson pilot, in the right hand.
panels.context: It tilts the aircraft to fly forward, back and sideways; it has no weapon buttons here.

controls.name: Cyclic
controls.text: Pushing the cyclic forward tips the Samson forward so it flies forward; moving it sideways makes it fly sideways.
controls.context: The pilot has no forward weapons, so the cyclic only flies; the guns are worked by the door gunners.

areas.name: Instrument panel
areas.text: Displays in front of the two pilots.

panels.name: Instrument panel
panels.text: Displays in front of the pilot and the co-pilot of the Samson.
panels.context: They show the flight data for both pilots.

controls.name: Flight displays
controls.text: Screens in front of both pilots show the flight data.
controls.context: The pilots watch them while flying low over the forest of Pandora.

areas.name: Co-pilot seat
areas.text: The second seat beside the pilot.

panels.name: Co-pilot seat
panels.text: The second seat beside the pilot, with its own controls.
panels.context: A second pilot can fly or help with the systems.

controls.name: Co-pilot seat
controls.text: The co-pilot's seat has a second set of flight controls.
controls.context: Either pilot can fly the Samson.

areas.name: Open cabin and door guns
areas.text: The cabin with side doors behind the cockpit.

panels.name: Open cabin and door guns
panels.text: The cabin behind the cockpit, open at the sides, with door guns and seats.
panels.context: It carries soldiers and cargo; the door gunners protect the aircraft.

controls.name: Door guns
controls.text: Guns on swivel mounts in the doors, worked by door gunners, not by the pilot.
controls.context: They cover the sides of the aircraft while the pilot flies.

controls.name: Troop seats
controls.text: Seats in the cabin for soldiers or passengers.
controls.context: The Samson carries people and cargo around Pandora.
